name: Venomancer: Barbed Stinger throw, recast rip and Exposed Flesh extension
contract: Barbed Stinger 803196 has a 20 s cooldown. It clears Exposed Flesh 805095 and flings a stinger 803206 into
the enemy for 10 s plus 1 s per cleared stack; a recast on the same target rips it out with 803208, pulling
the target and dealing Nature damage that scales with how long the stinger stayed in (680854 stacks).
Spell.dbc 803196 effect 2 triggers 803220 (db.exil.es 'Barbed Stinger Reset Effect'), whose effect 165
takes 19001 ms off 803196's cooldown, and 803192 (the stinger's hit) triggers both 803208 and 803206.
A live combat log (C:/CoA/SUB/old-logs/09.txt, 2026-08-09 16:40:01-16:40:11) shows the recast 1.4 s after
the throw, the 803208 rip followed by a new 803206 in the target, and the cooldown still running 8 s later.

steps.label: Let spawn settle
Enter Beetle Form: Barbed Stinger requires 803183
SETUP: v is in Beetle Form
SETUP: x is in Beetle Form
Clear the GCD from entering Beetle Form
Throw the stinger
The stinger 803206 is in the target
Without Exposed Flesh the stinger lasts 10 s
The throw leaves about one second of Barbed Stinger cooldown
Let the stinger build 680854 stacks
The stinger adds a 680854 stack every second
Each 680854 stack adds 50% to the rip's damage taken
SETUP: the target is still 8 yards away
Recast on the same target
The recast is accepted
The recast rips the stinger out with 803208
The rip pulls the target to the caster
The rip clears the old 680854 stacks
The recast leaves a new stinger in the target
The rip keeps the full cooldown
Molt grants Exposed Flesh stacks
SETUP: x has at least ten Exposed Flesh stacks
Clear the GCD from Molt
Throw with Exposed Flesh
The throw clears Exposed Flesh
SETUP: the stinger is in the second target
Each cleared stack adds a second to the stinger
